description: A bearded, heavily built man with a brow ridge and shaggy dark hair stands on a snowy hillside, wrapped in a brown fur cloak over bare shoulders and chest, gripping a long wooden spear with a stone tip in one hand and a walking stick in the other. Behind him a winding river runs through a valley of conifers under a dark, stormy sky with distant hills. The scene is a painting with no visible frame, text, or border, and the image fills the canvas edge to edge.
